    { rm -f "$t/.devvm-save/claude.json"; : > "$t/.devvm-save/claude-unreadable"; }
fi
tar -cf - "$@" -C "$t" .devvm-save

devvm_opencode_clean() {
  local t s c left
  rm -f clean.db clean.db-journal clean.db-wal clean.db-shm &&
  t=$(sqlite3 -bail "$1" '.timeout 10000' 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' "VACUUM INTO 'clean.db'" 'SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'';') || return 1
  case $t in '' | 0 | *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  [ "$(sqlite3 -bail clean.db 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' 'SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'';')" = "$t" ] &&
  s=$(sqlite3 -bail clean.db 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' 'SELECT printf('\''DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "%w";'\'', name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''trigger'\'';
SELECT printf('\''DELETE FROM "%w";'\'', name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name NOT LIKE '\''sqlite\_%'\'' ESCAPE '\''\'\'' AND (name LIKE '\''%credential%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%account%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%auth%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%secret%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%token%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%share%'\'' OR name IN (SELECT m.name FROM sqlite_master m JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) c WHERE m.type = '\''table'\'' AND lower(c.name) IN ('\''secret'\'', '\''access_token'\'', '\''refresh_token'\'', '\''id_token'\'', '\''api_key'\'', '\''apikey'\'', '\''password'\'', '\''token'\'', '\''credential'\'', '\''credentials'\'')));
SELECT '\''DELETE FROM migration WHERE id = '\'''\''20260805200742_import_legacy_credentials'\'''\'';'\'' FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name = '\''migration'\'';
SELECT '\''DELETE FROM kv WHERE key LIKE '\'''\''wellknown:config:%'\'''\'';'\'' FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name = '\''kv'\'';') &&
  printf 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;\nPRAGMA journal_mode = DELETE;\nPRAGMA secure_delete = ON;\n%s\nVACUUM;\n' "$s" | sqlite3 -bail clean.db >/dev/null &&
  c=$(sqlite3 -bail clean.db 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' 'SELECT '\''SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\'''\''trigger'\'''\'';'\'';
SELECT printf('\''SELECT count(*) FROM "%w";'\'', name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name NOT LIKE '\''sqlite\_%'\'' ESCAPE '\''\'\'' AND (name LIKE '\''%credential%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%account%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%auth%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%secret%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%token%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%share%'\'' OR name IN (SELECT m.name FROM sqlite_master m JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) c WHERE m.type = '\''table'\'' AND lower(c.name) IN ('\''secret'\'', '\''access_token'\'', '\''refresh_token'\'', '\''id_token'\'', '\''api_key'\'', '\''apikey'\'', '\''password'\'', '\''token'\'', '\''credential'\'', '\''credentials'\'')));
SELECT '\''SELECT count(*) FROM kv WHERE key LIKE '\'''\''wellknown:config:%'\'''\'';'\'' FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name = '\''kv'\'';') && [ -n "$c" ] &&
  left=$(printf 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;\n%s\n' "$c" | sqlite3 -bail clean.db) && [ -n "$left" ] &&
  [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$left" | grep -cx 0)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | grep -c '')" ] &&
  ! printf '%s\n' "$left" | grep -qvx 0 || return 1
  [ ! -e clean.db-wal ] && [ ! -e clean.db-journal ]
}
mkdir -p ~/.cache && t=$(mktemp -d ~/.cache/devvm-export.XXXXXX) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT
mkdir "$t/devvm-clean" && cd "$t" || exit 1
add=()
for db in "$HOME"/'.local/share/opencode'/opencode*.db; do
  [ -f "$db" ] && [ ! -L "$db" ] || continue
  n=${db##*/}
  if ! command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null; then echo "devvm: left out $db: the VM has no sqlite3" >&2
  elif devvm_opencode_clean "$db" && mv clean.db "devvm-clean/$n" && add=(${add[@]+"${add[@]}"} "devvm-clean/$n"); then continue
  else echo "devvm: left out $db: its copy without opencode's logins failed" >&2
  fi
  :
done
[ "${#add[@]}" -eq 0 ] || add=(-C "$t" "${add[@]}")
cd ~ && ls -d .claude .claude.json .codex .local/share/opencode .local/state/opencode .pi/agent/sessions 2>/dev/null | tar -czf - '--exclude=.claude/.credentials.json' '--exclude=.codex/auth.json' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/auth.json' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/account.json' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/mcp-auth.json' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/bin' '--no-wildcards-match-slash' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/opencode*.db' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/opencode*.db-wal' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/opencode*.db-shm' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/opencode*.db-journal' '--transform=flags=r;s,^devvm-clean/,.local/share/opencode/,' -T - ${add[@]+"${add[@]}"}
import script
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p ~/.cache && t=$(mktemp -d ~/.cache/devvm-import.XXXXXX) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT
cat > "$t/export" && tar -tzf "$t/export" --absolute-names --quoting-style=escape > "$t/names" || exit 1
if grep -vqE '^(\.claude|\.claude\.json|\.codex|\.local/share/opencode|\.local/state/opencode|\.pi/agent/sessions)(/|$)' "$t/names" || grep -qE '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)' "$t/names"; then echo devvm-history-unsafe; exit 1; fi
mkdir "$t/x" && tar -xzf "$t/export" -C "$t/x" '--no-same-owner' '--no-same-permissions' '--anchored' '--exclude=.claude.json' '--exclude=.claude/.credentials.json' '--exclude=.claude/CLAUDE.md' '--exclude=.claude/agents' '--exclude=.claude/commands' '--exclude=.claude/output-styles' '--exclude=.claude/plugins' '--exclude=.claude/settings.json' '--exclude=.claude/skills' '--exclude=.codex/AGENTS.md' '--exclude=.codex/auth.json' '--exclude=.codex/config.toml' '--exclude=.codex/prompts' '--exclude=.codex/skills' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/account.json' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/auth.json' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/bin' '--exclude=.local/share/opencode/mcp-auth.json' '--exclude=.pi/agent/AGENTS.md' '--exclude=.pi/agent/APPEND_SYSTEM.md' '--exclude=.pi/agent/SYSTEM.md' '--exclude=.pi/agent/extensions' '--exclude=.pi/agent/keybindings.json' '--exclude=.pi/agent/mcp.json' '--exclude=.pi/agent/models.json' '--exclude=.pi/agent/prompts' '--exclude=.pi/agent/settings.json' '--exclude=.pi/agent/skills' '--exclude=.pi/agent/themes' || exit 1
find "$t/x" -type l -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' l; do
  case $(readlink "$l") in /* | .. | ../* | */.. | */../*) echo "devvm: left out the link $l" >&2; rm -f "$l" ;; esac
done
devvm_opencode_clean() {
  local t s c left
  rm -f clean.db clean.db-journal clean.db-wal clean.db-shm &&
  t=$(sqlite3 -bail "$1" '.timeout 10000' 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' "VACUUM INTO 'clean.db'" 'SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'';') || return 1
  case $t in '' | 0 | *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  [ "$(sqlite3 -bail clean.db 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' 'SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'';')" = "$t" ] &&
  s=$(sqlite3 -bail clean.db 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' 'SELECT printf('\''DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "%w";'\'', name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''trigger'\'';
SELECT printf('\''DELETE FROM "%w";'\'', name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name NOT LIKE '\''sqlite\_%'\'' ESCAPE '\''\'\'' AND (name LIKE '\''%credential%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%account%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%auth%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%secret%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%token%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%share%'\'' OR name IN (SELECT m.name FROM sqlite_master m JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) c WHERE m.type = '\''table'\'' AND lower(c.name) IN ('\''secret'\'', '\''access_token'\'', '\''refresh_token'\'', '\''id_token'\'', '\''api_key'\'', '\''apikey'\'', '\''password'\'', '\''token'\'', '\''credential'\'', '\''credentials'\'')));
SELECT '\''DELETE FROM migration WHERE id = '\'''\''20260805200742_import_legacy_credentials'\'''\'';'\'' FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name = '\''migration'\'';
SELECT '\''DELETE FROM kv WHERE key LIKE '\'''\''wellknown:config:%'\'''\'';'\'' FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name = '\''kv'\'';') &&
  printf 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;\nPRAGMA journal_mode = DELETE;\nPRAGMA secure_delete = ON;\n%s\nVACUUM;\n' "$s" | sqlite3 -bail clean.db >/dev/null &&
  c=$(sqlite3 -bail clean.db 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;' 'SELECT '\''SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\'''\''trigger'\'''\'';'\'';
SELECT printf('\''SELECT count(*) FROM "%w";'\'', name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name NOT LIKE '\''sqlite\_%'\'' ESCAPE '\''\'\'' AND (name LIKE '\''%credential%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%account%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%auth%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%secret%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%token%'\'' OR name LIKE '\''%share%'\'' OR name IN (SELECT m.name FROM sqlite_master m JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) c WHERE m.type = '\''table'\'' AND lower(c.name) IN ('\''secret'\'', '\''access_token'\'', '\''refresh_token'\'', '\''id_token'\'', '\''api_key'\'', '\''apikey'\'', '\''password'\'', '\''token'\'', '\''credential'\'', '\''credentials'\'')));
SELECT '\''SELECT count(*) FROM kv WHERE key LIKE '\'''\''wellknown:config:%'\'''\'';'\'' FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '\''table'\'' AND name = '\''kv'\'';') && [ -n "$c" ] &&
  left=$(printf 'PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF;\n%s\n' "$c" | sqlite3 -bail clean.db) && [ -n "$left" ] &&
  [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$left" | grep -cx 0)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | grep -c '')" ] &&
  ! printf '%s\n' "$left" | grep -qvx 0 || return 1
  [ ! -e clean.db-wal ] && [ ! -e clean.db-journal ]
}
o="$t/x/"'.local/share/opencode'
for f in "$o"/opencode*.db-wal "$o"/opencode*.db-shm "$o"/opencode*.db-journal; do rm -rf "$f"; done
for f in "$o"/opencode*.db; do if [ -L "$f" ] || { [ -e "$f" ] && [ ! -f "$f" ]; }; then rm -rf "$f"; fi; done
cd "$t" || exit 1
for db in "$o"/opencode*.db; do
  [ -f "$db" ] && [ ! -L "$db" ] || continue
  n=${db##*/}
  if ! command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null; then echo "devvm: left out $db: the VM has no sqlite3" >&2
  elif devvm_opencode_clean "$db" && mv clean.db "$db"; then continue
  else echo "devvm: left out $db: its copy without opencode's logins failed" >&2
  fi
  rm -f "$db"
done
cd "$t/x" && set -- && for p in '.claude' '.claude.json' '.codex' '.local/share/opencode' '.local/state/opencode' '.pi/agent/sessions'; do if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then set -- "$@" "$p"; fi; done
[ "$#" -eq 0 ] || tar -cf - "$@" | tar --extract --file=- --directory ~ --skip-old-files '--no-same-owner' '--no-same-permissions'
